أنمحي (form VII)
# أَنْمَحِي (ʔanmaḥī) /ʔan.ma.ħiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْمَحَى (inmaḥā)
# أَنْمَحِيَ (ʔanmaḥiya) /ʔan.ma.ħi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْمَحَى (inmaḥā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
